name: Critical Effects (DH2): Rending - Head
description: Dark Heresy 2nd Edition, Table 7-21 (p. 241). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: 1 level of Fatigue. No effect if the target wears a helmet.
-10 to Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill tests for [[1d10]] rounds. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or suffer Blood Loss.
Stunned for 1 round and Blood Loss. Any helmet is torn off.
[[1d10]] Perception damage. Routine (+20) Toughness test; on a failure he gains the Lost Eye condition.

The helmet is torn off; with no helmet he loses an ear instead and is Deafened until medical attention, plus a Challenging (+0) Toughness test or Fellowship permanently reduced by 1. Stunned for [[1d5]] rounds.

[[1d5]] levels of Fatigue and Blood Loss. Roll [[1d10]] for the feature lost - 1-3: an eye (Lost Eye condition); 4-7: the nose, Fellowship permanently reduced by [[1d10]]; 8-10: an ear, Deafened until medical attention.
Stunned for 1 round, Blood Loss and permanently Blinded. Fellowship permanently reduced by [[1d10]].
The target dies; his head lands [[2d10]] metres away.
As result 9. Everyone within [[1d5]] metres must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility test or take -10 to Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill tests for 1 round.
